title: BC Backcountry Helicopter Tours (Depart SKY Hangar)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Prepare for an unforgettable journey into the pristine wilderness of the Coast Mountains, where rugged peaks, ancient forests, and turquoise lakes await. Choose between a 30, 45, 60 or 90 minute helicopter experience in the pristine backcountry of British Columbia. From the moment you lift off, you'll be immersed in a landscape of unparalleled beauty. Feel the thrill as you soar over lush valleys and cascading waterfalls, with panoramic views that stretch as far as the eye can see. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, adventure seeker, or simply seeking a moment of serenity amidst breathtaking scenery, our BC Backcountry Heli-Tour promises an experience like no other. Capture stunning photographs of alpine meadows and towering mountains from the comfort of our modern helicopters, designed for optimal viewing and safety. 

SINGLE PASSENGERS: We require a minimum of TWO purchased seats of any flight in order to depart. Our team will do their best to pair you up with other passengers
